meta_desc: Chiverengi chemataira chemahara. Isa hukuru hwepasi kana madziro, hukuru hwetaira nemukaha wegrout uwane nhamba yemataira nemabhokisi pamwe nekurasika.
og_desc: Wana nhamba yemataira nemabhokisi epasi kana madziro ako, kurasika kwakabatanidzwa. Mahara, hapana kushambadza.
lede: Verenga kuti unoda mataira nemabhokisi mangani epasi kana madziro, mukaha wegrout nekurasika zvakabatanidzwa. Mahara, pakarepo, hapana kushambadza.
gap_hint_metric: 0 kana pasina mukaha. 3 mm inowanzoshandiswa pamataira epasi.
perbox_hint: Zvakanyorwa pabhokisi. Siya pasina kuti usazviverengera.
how_text: Chiverengi chinogovanisa nzvimbo yako nenzvimbo inotorwa netaira rimwe pamwe nemukaha waro wegrout, chowedzera kurasika kwekucheka nekutyoka, chokwidza kusvika pamataira akazara:
formula:
nzvimbo chaiyo yetaira = (upamhi hwetaira + mukaha) × (kureba kwetaira + mukaha)
mataira = ceil( nzvimbo / nzvimbo chaiyo yetaira × (1 + kurasika) )
mabhokisi = ceil( mataira / mataira pabhokisi )
how_text2: Kurasika i10% pamaisirwo akatwasuka uye 15% pakatsveyama kana herringbone, pane zvimedu zvakawanda zvakachekwa zvisingashandiswe. Mukaha wegrout wakafara unoreva kuti taira rimwe nerimwe rinotora nzvimbo yakati kurei, saka nhamba yemataira inodzika zvishoma.
example_imperial: Ngatiti uri kuisa mataira papasi pe10 ft ne12 ft, inova 120 sq ft (17,280 sq in), nemataira e12 x 12 inch akaiswa akatwasuka nemukaha wegrout we1/8 inch (0.125 in). Taira rimwe nemukaha waro rinotora 12.125 × 12.125 = 147.02 sq in, saka kuvhara kusina kurasika i17,280 / 147.02 = 117.54 mataira. Wedzera 10% kurasika: 117.54 × 1.1 = 129.29, zvinokwidzwa kusvika mataira 130. Kana mataira achiuya 8 pabhokisi, izvi i ceil(130 / 8) = mabhokisi 17. Pasi rimwe chete rakaiswa zvakatsveyama ne15% kurasika rinoda mataira 136.
example_metric: Ngatiti uri kuisa mataira papasi pe4 m ne3 m, inova 12 m² (120,000 cm²), nemataira e30 x 30 cm akaiswa akatwasuka nemukaha wegrout we3 mm (0.3 cm). Taira rimwe nemukaha waro rinotora 30.3 × 30.3 = 918.09 cm², saka kuvhara kusina kurasika i120,000 / 918.09 = 130.71 mataira. Wedzera 10% kurasika: 130.71 × 1.1 = 143.78, zvinokwidzwa kusvika mataira 144. Kana mataira achiuya 11 pabhokisi, izvi i ceil(144 / 11) = mabhokisi 14. Pasi rimwe chete rakaiswa zvakatsveyama ne15% kurasika rinoda mataira 151.
table_note: Hukuru hwemataira hunowanzoitwa, maisirwo akatwasuka ne10% kurasika uye pasina mukaha wegrout:
more_text: Uri kuronga rimwe basa? Edza zvimwe zviverengi zvemahara:
faq: Ndinofanira kutenga mataira akawedzerwa akawanda sei?

Tenga 10 kusvika 15% kupfuura nhamba yekuvhara isina kurasika. Kucheka pamadziro, kutyoka nekugadzirisa kweramangwana zvese zvinodya zvakawedzerwa. Shandisa 10% pamaisirwo akatwasuka ari nyore mumba ine mativi mana, uye 15% pamaisirwo akatsveyama kana herringbone, mataira madiki, kana dzimba dzine makona akawanda.

Kurasika itaira raunotenga asi risingazofambwi pariri: zvimedu zvakachekwa pamadziro nekutenderedza zvigadzirwa, mataira anotsemuka pakucheka kana pakutakura, uye asara anochengeterwa kugadzirisa kwepashure. Izvi zvakajairika, hachisi chikanganiso. Chiverengi ichi chinowedzera pesenti yekurasika chisati chakwidza kusvika pamataira akazara.
Ndinoda mataira mangani e12x12 pa100 square feet?

Taira re12x12 inch (30x30 cm) rinovhara square foot 1, saka 100 square feet (9.3 m²) zvinoda mataira 100 pasina kurasika. Wedzera 10% kurasika pamaisirwo akatwasuka uye unofanira kutenga mataira 110. Nemukaha wegrout taira rimwe nerimwe rinovhara zvishoma kupfuura, saka nhamba inogona kudzika zvishoma.
Maisirwo akatsveyama anoda mataira akawanda here?

Hongu. Kuisa mataira pamadhigirii 45 kunoreva kuti mutsara wega wega unopera nekucheka kwakatsveyama pamadziro, uye zvimedu zvakawanda izvozvo hazvigone kushandiswa zvakare. Ronga anenge 15% kurasika pamaisirwo akatsveyama kana herringbone pachinzvimbo che10% yakajairika pamaisirwo akatwasuka.
Ndinoverengera mitsetse yegrout here pakuverenga mataira?

Hongu, uye inokubatsira. Taira rimwe nerimwe pamwe nemukaha waro wegrout, kazhinji 1/8 inch (3 mm), rinotora nzvimbo yakati kurei pane taira roga, saka mukaha wakafara unoderedza zvishoma nhamba yemataira anodiwa. Mhedzisiro yacho idiki nemataira makuru asi inooneka nemataira madiki esubway.
